ResourcesToBuild.description: The definitions of the entities to build

content.description: The definitions: a list of definitions, a single definition, or yaml (several documents separated by `---` lines)

oneOf.description: Yaml definitions, one document per entity
oneOf.example:
kind: proxy.otoroshi.io/Route
name: my-route
frontend:
  domains:
    - my-route.oto.tools
---
kind: apim.otoroshi.io/Apikey
clientName: my-key

ResourceDefinition.description: A partial definition of an entity: its `kind` and the fields that differ from its template, or a kubernetes like resource holding them in its `spec`

BuiltResources.description: The entities built from the definitions

created.description: The entity built for a single definition, or the entities built for a list of definitions (and for yaml documents), in their order

oneOf.description: The entities built, in the order of the definitions

BuiltResourceOutcome.description: An entity built, or the error of its definition

BuiltResource.description: An entity built from its definition

kind.description: The kind of the entity, as read from its definition (a service descriptor becomes `proxy.otoroshi.io/Route`)

resource.description: The complete entity: the template of its kind merged with its definition. Its schema is the one of its kind

BuiltResourceError.description: A definition that could not be built

error.description: Why it could not be built: an unknown kind, or a definition its format refuses

name.description: The `name` of the definition, `Unknown` when it has none
